claim: The owner, of Gravesend (2026-11-24): sectors there were lit with no apparent source, and a light made to blink should also change the neighbouring sectors it lights. We hold every lamp that blinks, goes out or travels to it.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-24: 'there are light sectors withou apparent source of light, when you made light blinking it should also affect neighbouring sectors that are lit by that light' (the second half quoted in projects/blood-city/level/phantom_terminus.py:881-883)
use: Hang lamps and let the light stage trace them rather than painting pools; a lamp that switches is a LampGroup and switch_lamps gives all its sectors the same wave and wire. It skips a sector that already sends (a secret) or listens on another channel: given the lamp's wire, a sender would send when the lamp changes.

checked.how: Owner's words found at memory lamps-switch-their-light.md:10 and (second half) projects/blood-city/level/phantom_terminus.py:881-883 (light_groups): 'there are light sectors withou apparent source of light, when you made light blinking it should also affect neighbouring sectors that are lit by that light' (2026-11-24), said of Gravesend's Phantom Terminus. He named blinking; 'goes out or travels' is our extension. light_stage.py:981 LampGroup, :1075 switch_lamps; :1119-1123 refuses a sector with tx_id or another rx_id (the reason is that it would send, not one rx).
